review_text:
caDNAno export compatibility

These features in the current design will change or be omitted. Keep the .nadoc file as your complete design.

Crossover annotations (38): Crossover operation labels and junction IDs are not retained.
Assigned strand sequences (11): caDNAno v2 JSON does not store strand sequences. Export the sequence table separately.
Negative nucleotide coordinates (1): All nucleotide labels shift by +21 to fit caDNAno arrays; relative offsets are retained.
Recipe root (6): Not retained in this format; the .nadoc file retains this information.
Lattice frames (1): Not retained in this format; the .nadoc file retains this information.
Cluster membership and transforms (1): Not retained in this format; the .nadoc file retains this information.
Document history (1): Not retained in this format; the .nadoc file retains this information.
Loadouts (1): Not retained in this format; the .nadoc file retains this information.
Feature log (3): Not retained in this format; the .nadoc file retains this information.
Helix coordinates and phase (6): Only lattice cells, nucleotide paths and insertions/deletions are exported. Absolute axis placement, phase and custom twist are reconstructed by the receiving application.
